It contains short paragraphs and embedded images so you can test whether column-aware extraction produces readable output. The layout is intentionally narrow and mirrors the kind of print digest often used for morning media reviews. Coverage this week highlighted policy debates, AI funding optimism, and a surge in weekend sports clips. Regional desks also logged multilingual mentions including Žurnal, São Paulo, München, and café references. These characters are useful for testing whether normalization preserves accented text during extraction. A common strategy for multi-column PDFs is to split each page into left and right regions, extract both halves separately, normalize whitespace, and concatenate the results in reading order. This avoids jumbled lines when extractors read across the page instead of down the first column. Analysts can further attach metadata such as source file, page number, extraction date, and processing library so that downstream search or audit tasks remain transparent. Once stored in MongoDB, the document content can be searched alongside article feeds gathered from APIs and scraped websites. ring Brief — mn Sample ing with pdfplumber crop strategy In production, a simple logging trail should capture document name, success state, encoding notes, and any extraction warnings. That makes it easier to compare normal PDFs, two-column PDFs, Word documents, and Excel sheets inside one reproducible pipeline. The monitoring team can also compare issue salience by source, category, and region. Even a lightweight lab pipeline benefits from consistent metadata, because it lets you trace which parser produced each record and when that record entered the database. If a page uses a strong newspaper-style layout, a left-right crop method is often enough to recover the intended order. When tables or images appear, they can be stored separately as supporting content, while normalized text remains searchable as a clean field in MongoDB.

Fotografija nazvana Earthrise prikazuje Zemlju kako izlazi iznad horizonta Mieseca i promijenila je nacin na koji Ijudi gledaju na svoju planetu. Clanovi posade misije Artemis Il napravili su tek prvu od ko zna koliko nevjerovatnih fotografija Zemlje iz svemira. el lInOS Samo ONLINE Fotografiju "Earthrise" je snimio astronaut William Anders koristeci kameru Hasselblad 500 EL, koja je bila posebno modifikovana za svemir. Fotografija nije snimljena digitalno, nego na 70 mm filmu, a razvijena je tek nakon povratka astronauta na Zemlju. O njenom rezultatu i uspjesnosti znali su tek po povratku na zemlju. Medutim, i sami aparat koji su nosili tokom misije bio je posebno napravljen. Objektiv kojim je snimljena fotografija bio je Zeiss Sonnar 250mm f/5.6, koji je proizvela njemacka kompanija Carl Zeiss, a Cemu smo pisali prilikom posjete muzeju.
